faq.a1: Code products are delivered right after payment. Top-ups handled by our team usually take 5 to 30 minutes during business hours.
faq.q2: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: MonCash (automatic) and NatCash (checked by our team). You can also pay from your Haiti Gaming wallet.
faq.q3: Can I withdraw money from my wallet?
faq.a3: No. The wallet is store credit: you can top it up, exchange between HTG and USD, and spend it on Haiti Gaming.
faq.a4: If we cannot deliver, the full amount is returned to your wallet and you are notified.

pages.aboutBody: Haiti Gaming is a Haitian online store for game top-ups, gift cards and digital subscriptions. We make it easy to pay with the mobile money you already use, and we answer in your language.
pages.contactBody: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp. You can also open a support request from any order.
guideMoncash: Choose MonCash at checkout or when adding money to your wallet.
You are sent to the MonCash page. Enter your MonCash phone number.
Enter the code MonCash sends you, then your PIN to approve.
You come back to Haiti Gaming automatically. Your payment is confirmed in seconds.
guideNatcash: Choose NatCash at checkout or when adding money to your wallet.
Open NatCash and send the exact amount to the number shown.
Copy the transaction reference from the NatCash confirmation.
Enter the reference on Haiti Gaming. Our team checks it, usually within 30 minutes.
pages.guidePlayerIdTitle: How to find your Free Fire player ID
guidePlayerId: Open Free Fire and tap your profile picture at the top left.
Your player ID is the number under your name.
Copy it exactly. A wrong ID sends the diamonds to someone else.
termsBody: Haiti Gaming sells digital products: game top-ups, gift cards, subscriptions and digital services.
You must provide accurate account information such as your player ID. Haiti Gaming is not responsible for deliveries made to an ID you entered incorrectly.
Wallet balances are store credit. They can be spent on Haiti Gaming or exchanged between HTG and USD at the rate shown, and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.
We may hold or review payments and orders to prevent fraud.
Product names and trademarks belong to their owners. Haiti Gaming is an independent reseller.
privacyBody: We collect your name, email, optional phone number, order details and payment references to provide the service.
Gift-card codes and payment information are stored encrypted.
We do not sell your data. We share only what payment and fulfillment providers need to complete your order.
You can ask us to export or delete your data by contacting support.

We only use necessary cookies: your sign-in, your language, a referral code if you followed an invite, and an anonymous browser ID that helps us stop fraud with multiple accounts. No advertising cookies.
refundsBody: If we cannot deliver your order, the full amount is returned to your Haiti Gaming wallet.
Codes that have been delivered cannot be refunded, because they can be used immediately.
If a top-up was sent to the wrong player ID because of a typing error, we cannot recover it.
Contact us on WhatsApp with your order number for any problem.
